verdict.rationale: BVNK documents a sandbox environment that mirrors production with test data and lets developers simulate pay-ins/payouts (POST /payment/v2/payins/simulation) safely before going live, directly supporting rehearsal without real funds. However, evidence only covers pay-ins/payouts simulation explicitly; conversions/quotes simulation and deterministic test-value behavior are not documented, and there's no independent/hands-on corroboration of sandbox reliability. missing for 10: documented simulation of conversions/transfers, explicit deterministic test-value guarantees, independent developer confirmation of sandbox behavior.
